title: Near-optimal countable δ-covers for Hausdorff measure (Simon Ch. 2, proof of Thm 1.9, choice (1))
statement: Let X be an extended metric space with its Borel σ-algebra, d ∈ ℝ, s ⊆ X any set (not necessarily measurable), and r, ε ∈ [0, ∞] with r > 0 and ε ≠ 0. Let μH[d] be Mathlib's unnormalized d-dimensional Hausdorff measure on X: for every set s, μH[d](s) = sup_{ρ>0} inf{ Σ_{n∈ℕ} c_d(tₙ) : s ⊆ ⋃ₙ tₙ, diam tₙ ≤ ρ for all n }, where diam is the extended diameter, c_d(t) = diam(t)^d for t ≠ ∅, and c_d(∅) = 0. If μH[d](s) < ∞, then there is a sequence (tₙ)_{n∈ℕ} of subsets of X with s ⊆ ⋃ₙ tₙ, diam tₙ ≤ r for every n, and Σₙ c_d(tₙ) ≤ μH[d](s) + ε.
lean_statement: ∀ {X : Type} [EMetricSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (d : ℝ) (s : Set X) (r ε : ℝ≥0∞), 0 < r → ε ≠ 0 → μH[d] s ≠ ∞ → ∃ t : ℕ → Set X, s ⊆ ⋃ n, t n ∧ (∀ n, Metric.ediam (t n) ≤ r) ∧ ∑' n, ⨆ _ : (t n).Nonempty, Metric.ediam (t n) ^ d ≤ μH[d] s + ε
